observations.detail: A private in-ground blue pool is directly visible at the rear. The visible portion appears rectilinear; its complete nadir outline is UNKNOWN.
The residence has a large, symmetric two-wing mass around a central taller glazed entry volume, with predominantly flat/parapet roof planes and roof-edge detail visible from the supplied aerial.
A broad paved front approach and two large adjacent garage-door bays are directly visible. The internal garage capacity is UNKNOWN.
Immediate built neighbours are visible on both sides and behind. No ownership, parcel boundary, orientation, or wider-location inference is made from this view.
Distinctive visible elements include a centered tall glazed entry, balanced stone-clad garage-front panels, upper glass balustrades, and a central landscaped island between paired paved approaches.

The supplied oblique aerial shows the complete front roof mass and dense immediate context; the rear pool is not clearly visible from this angle. This is target visual evidence only and is not used to geolocate.
